description: This plot illustrates the relationship between "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" and two distinct metrics: "Perplexity" and "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)". The x-axis represents the "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from 10 to 100 with tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot features dual y-axes. The left y-axis represents "Perplexity" on a linear scale, ranging from 4.2 to 4.7 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis represents "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 100 with tick labels at intervals of 10. Four lines are displayed on the graph. The "Perplexity" data is represented by a solid orange line with circular markers, corresponding to the left y-axis; it begins at approximately 4.59 at an x-value of 10, declines to a local minimum of 4.30 at x=40, rises slightly to 4.34 at x=60, dips to 4.29 at x=70, and ends at approximately 4.38 at x=100. A dashed red line, also corresponding to the left y-axis (with an obscured legend label), maintains a constant horizontal value of approximately 4.38 across the entire x-axis range. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" data is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, corresponding to the right y-axis; it starts at approximately 40 at x=10, exhibits a gradual increase to approximately 55 at x=80, and then sharply rises to approximately 98 at x=90, concluding at 100 at x=100. Finally, the "Full Cache GPU Mem." is represented by a dashed blue line corresponding to the right y-axis, maintaining a constant horizontal value of 100 across the entire x-axis.
